description: List directory contents of a knowledge base. Returns file names, types, and sizes.
embedding_description: Navigate a knowledge base's file tree: list the entries inside one of its directories, returning each entry's name, type, and size. Read-only; it does not open file contents or change anything. Use to explore a KB's folder layout or see which files live under a path before reading or editing one.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Directory listing with file names and types
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Present as a file tree or list.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: KB or path not found.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use list_installed to verify KB name, or browse parent path.
